## claude.ai Era Context
Era Context is an MCP-first, agent-native personal finance management platform. Every capability is exposed via MCP tools, and professional users can also access the same data via REST API. The platform provides both read and write access to the user's finances across connected third-party accounts. Capabilities are organized into plan tiers: See, Organize, Automate, and Optimize.

## Tool domains

**Knowledge & Memory** — Centralized memory shared across all connected agents and the user's dashboard. Era Context may have pending onboarding or follow-up questions queued for the agent to ask — some unlock capabilities, others can be snoozed. Use these tools to surface questions, record answers, and capture facts, preferences, goals, or aspirations from natural conversation. Ambient observations (e.g. lifestyle preferences, financial goals, casual remarks) improve personalization over time. Facts can carry expiry dates for automatic re-verification. User data is never shared with third parties and is anonymized during any LLM inference conducted by Era Context.

**Accounts & Transactions** — Query balances, search and categorize transactions, manage tags across the user's connected accounts at third-party institutions.

**Insights & Analysis** — Spending breakdowns, cash flow, period comparisons, forecasting, and daily summaries.

**Automation & Rules** — User-defined rules for transaction cleanup, filtering, and categorization that execute automatically.

**Billing** — Current plan details and upgrade options. Capabilities vary by tier.

Upcoming: automated money movement between connected accounts; shared household views for group finance management.
